q: What is the main protagonist's full name in the Keeper of the Lost Cities series?
quote: Sophie Elizabeth Foster is raised in the human world before discovering she is an elf created by the Black Swan.

q: In which human city does Sophie Foster live with her human family at the beginning of Book 1?
quote: Sophie lives in San Diego, California, and is on a class field trip to the Balboa Park Natural History Museum when Fitz finds her.

q: Which elf finds twelve-year-old Sophie at a natural history museum and introduces her to the Lost Cities?
quote: Fitzroy Avery Vacker spots a newspaper article about a twelve-year-old child prodigy and locates Sophie at the museum.

q: What unusual eye color sets Sophie apart from every other elf in the Lost Cities?
quote: All natural-born elves have shades of blue eyes, whereas Sophie has warm brown eyes with flecks of gold from her alicorn DNA.

q: What is the first elvin ability Sophie manifests at age five after hitting her head?
quote: Sophie accidentally triggers her Telepathy at age five when she falls and hits her head on a curb.

q: What is Sophie's younger human sister originally named before her memories are erased and her family is relocated?
quote: Sophie's outspoken younger human sister is Amy Foster (who chooses the name Natalie when the Black Swan relocates the family).

q: Which couple adopts Sophie after Grady and Edaline Ruewen lose their daughter Jolie?
quote: Grady and Edaline Ruewen of Havenfield adopt Sophie as their ward and daughter.

q: What is the name of Grady and Edaline Ruewen's animal-filled estate where Sophie lives?
quote: Havenfield sits on rugged cliffs by the ocean and serves as a sanctuary testing pastures for creatures before they go to the Sanctuary.

q: What is the name of the Vacker family's grand estate surrounded by glowing silver trees?
quote: Alden and Della Vacker live at Everglen, a magnificent gated estate in the Lost Cities.

q: What is the special ability of Sophie's best friend Dex Dizznee?
quote: Dexter Alvin Dizznee manifests as a Technopath, someone with an innate talent for building and understanding gadgets.

q: What is the name of Dex's father's apothecary shop in Mysterium?
quote: Kesler Dizznee runs Slurps and Burps, an apothecary known for effective remedies that often have comical side effects.

q: What nickname does Keefe Sencen famously use to refer to his own signature hairstyle?
a: The Hair (and himself as Lord Hunkyhair)
quote: Keefe constantly brags about 'The Hair' and calls himself President of the Foster Fan Club and Lord Hunkyhair.

q: What is Keefe Sencen's primary elvin ability when he first meets Sophie?
quote: Keefe is a remarkably powerful Empath who can sense Sophie's emotions even without physical contact.

q: What is Biana Vacker's special ability?
quote: Like her mother Della, Biana manifests as a Vanisher capable of turning invisible to light.

q: What is Grady Ruewen's rare and feared elvin ability?
quote: Grady is a Mesmer, giving him the power to compel others to obey his mental commands.

q: What is Edaline Ruewen's special ability that lets her summon objects from anywhere with a snap of her fingers?
quote: Edaline is a Conjurer who can snap her fingers to transport stored objects through the void.

q: What kind of prehistoric creature is Verdi, the bright green pet living in Havenfield's pastures?
quote: Verdi is a feathery bright-green Tyrannosaurus rex who refuses to eat her vegetables despite being vegetarian.

q: What is the name of Sophie's mischievous pet imp that Dex dyes different colors?
quote: Sophie adopts an imp from Foxfire's alchemy dungeons and names him Iggy; Dex frequently gives him colorful makeovers.

q: What is the name of the glittering female alicorn (winged unicorn) who communicates telepathically with Sophie?
quote: Silveny is the first female alicorn discovered in millennia and forms a deep telepathic bond with Sophie.

q: What is the name of the prestigious academy that noble elves attend in the Lost Cities?
quote: Foxfire is a multi-colored glass pyramid academy where young elves train for the nobility.

q: Instead of teachers, what are the instructors at Foxfire called?
quote: Foxfire instructors are called Mentors and typically teach Prodigies in one-on-one or very small sessions.

q: Instead of students, what are the young elves studying at Foxfire called?
quote: Foxfire students are referred to as Prodigies, arranged by levels corresponding to their year of study.

q: What is the name of the towering, high-pitched goblin bodyguard assigned to protect Sophie?
quote: Sandor is a seven-foot-tall goblin warrior with an unexpectedly squeaky voice who is fiercely devoted to Sophie's safety.

q: How do elves primarily travel long distances across the world in a single moment?
a: Light leaping with a leaping crystal
quote: Elves angle a faceted crystal toward a beam of light and step into the path to leap to their destination on a beam of light.

q: What wristband device must young or unpracticed elves wear during light leaping so their molecules don't fade away?
quote: A nexus measures the wearer's concentration during light leaping and pulls their particles back together if their focus slips.

q: What is the name of Sophie's favorite elvin dessert, often baked by Edaline and described as warm, gooey cake with melted chocolate and butterscotch?
quote: Mallowmelt is Sophie's absolute favorite elvin dessert, especially when topped with custard and ice cream.

q: How many Councillors sit on the elvin Council that rules the Lost Cities?
quote: The Council consists of twelve unmarried leaders who govern the elvin world from Eternalia.

q: What is the capital city of the Lost Cities, home to the twelve Councillors' crystal castles?
quote: Eternalia is the glittering capital of the Lost Cities where each Councillor resides in a personal crystal castle.

q: Which secret rebel organization created Sophie's tweaked genetics under the codename 'Project Moonlark'?
quote: The Black Swan engineered Sophie's DNA as Project Moonlark to help wake the elvin world from dangerous complacency.

q: What is the name of the violent criminal extremist group wearing black cloaks with a white eyeless swan/circle motif that opposes both the Council and the Black Swan?
quote: The Neverseen is the ruthless rebel organization that seeks to overthrow the elvin system through force.

q: Which twin brother and sister join Sophie's circle of friends after attending Exillium?
quote: Tam and Linh Song are twins banished to Exillium after Linh accidentally flooded Atlantis.

q: What is Tam Song's elvin ability?
quote: Tam is a powerful Shade who manipulates shadows and shadowvapor, as well as reading a person's shadowvapor.

q: What is Linh Song's elvin ability?
quote: Linh is an extraordinary Hydrokinetic who can control massive amounts of water.

q: Who is the eccentric, glasses-wearing Flasher physician at Foxfire's Healing Center who treats Sophie's countless injuries?
quote: Elwin Heslege is Foxfire's caring physician who uses coloured light orbs to diagnose and heal Sophie and gives her stuffed animals.

q: Which five special abilities does Sophie Foster ultimately manifest across the series?
a: Telepath, Empath, Mesmer, Vanisher, and Teleporter
Telepath, Polyglot, Flasher, Conjurer, and Inflictor
Telepath, Polyglot, Inflictor, Teleporter, and Enhancer
Telepath, Shade, Hydrokinetic, Teleporter, and Enhancer
quote: Sophie manifests five abilities: Telepath, Polyglot, Inflictor, Teleporter, and Enhancer.

q: Which forbidden ability causes the Council to outlaw its training after Fintan sparks Everblaze and Brant kills Jolie?
quote: Pyrokinesis is outlawed in the Lost Cities because Pyrokinetics can summon Everblaze, a fire that cannot be extinguished by normal water.

q: Which of Sophie's friends from Foxfire secretly manifests as a Pyrokinetic and trains with Fintan and later Linh?
quote: Marella Redek manifests as a Pyrokinetic and seeks training so she can control her flames and help her mother Caprise.

q: Whose death in a tragic fire before Book 1 left Grady and Edaline Ruewen isolated in grief for sixteen years?
quote: Jolie Ruewen died in a fire sparked by her fiancé Brant when she discovered he was part of the Neverseen.

q: Who is gradually revealed to have been Jolie Ruewen's fiancé—and an unregistered Pyrokinetic working for the Neverseen?
quote: Brant was an unregistered Pyrokinetic and member of the Neverseen; Jolie died in the fire when she confronted him.

q: Why is Dex's family looked down upon by elvin nobility despite Kesler being a skilled apothecary and Juline being a nobility member?
a: His father was banished to Exillium as a teenager
They refused to register for registry pendants
His mother gave up her ability as a Froster
His parents were listed as a Bad Match AND had triplets (Rex, Bex, and Lex)
quote: In elvin society, both ignoble 'Bad Matches' outside matchmaking lists and multiple births (like triplets) carry heavy social stigma.

q: Who is the Beguiler who serves as Principal of Foxfire at the start of the series before later becoming a Councillor?
quote: Dame Alina is a Beguiler who serves as Principal of Foxfire until Kenric's death opens a seat on the Council.

q: Which Councillor is Sophie's strongest supporter on the Council in the early books and tragically perishes in the Everblaze during Book 3?
quote: Kenric Fathan is an upbeat, red-haired Telepath Councillor who dies in Fintan's Everblaze while saving Oralie in Book 3 (Everblaze).

q: Which soft-spoken, pink-clad Empath Councillor is revealed in Book 8 (Legacy) to be Sophie's biological mother?
quote: In Legacy, Sophie discovers that Councillor Oralie donated her genetic material to Mr. Forkle for Project Moonlark.

q: What is the name of the swollen, wrinkly-skinned member of the Black Swan's Collective who watched over Sophie as her human neighbor in San Diego?
quote: Mr. Forkle posed as Sophie's eccentric neighbor in San Diego while eating ruckleberries to disguise his appearance.

q: Which three other identities in the Lost Cities are simultaneously held by Mr. Forkle (and his identical twin brother)?
a: Magnate Leto, Sir Astin, and Admiral Riswyck
Sir Tiergan, Elwin Heslege, and Quinlin Sonden
Alden Vacker, Lord Cassius, and Kesler Dizznee
quote: Mr. Forkle and his twin shared the identities of Mr. Forkle, Magnate Leto (Foxfire principal), Sir Astin (Universe Mentor), and Admiral Riswyck.

q: How could Mr. Forkle appear to be in two places at once and survive after one 'Mr. Forkle' was killed by the Neverseen in Lodestar?
a: He used a body-duplicating illusion device built by Tinker
Mr. Forkle was actually a pair of identical twin brothers sharing a single life and identity
He was a Phase-shifter who created a solid hologram clone
He transferred his consciousness into a backup clone body
quote: To avoid the elvin stigma against twins and protect Project Moonlark, the two identical brothers secretly lived as one person.

q: Which Telepath Mentor at Foxfire is secretly 'Granite' on the Black Swan's Collective and adoptive guardian to Wylie Endal?
quote: Sir Tiergan is Sophie's Telepathy Mentor, Wylie's adoptive guardian, and the Black Swan Collective member known as Granite.

q: Which Froster—who is also Dex's mother and Edaline's sister—is secretly 'Squall' on the Black Swan's Collective?
quote: Juline Dizznee is revealed to be Squall, the Froster on the Black Swan's Collective.

q: Which Flasher physician—also Quinlin Sonden's estranged wife—is secretly 'Physic', the medic of the Black Swan's Collective?
quote: Livvy Sonden is a Flasher physician and Black Swan Collective member who went by the codename Physic.

q: Who is the Keeper for the Black Swan who was imprisoned in Exile, resulting in Alden's guilt-triggered memory break?
quote: Prentice Endal (Wylie's father) was a Keeper for the Black Swan who called Swan Song before being captured and sent to Exile.

q: Who is Keefe Sencen's ruthless mother and one of the core leaders of the Neverseen behind Project Stellarlune?
quote: Lady Gisela is a Polyglot and mastermind within the Neverseen who manipulates Keefe's upbringing for her 'legacy'.

q: Which member of the Vacker family betrays the Lost Cities and reveals in Book 4 (Neverseen) that he is working with the Neverseen?
quote: Fitz and Biana's older brother Alvar Vacker is a Vanisher who secretly joined the Neverseen.

q: What rare telepathic partnership do Sophie and Fitz train to achieve so they can share thoughts effortlessly and boost their mental power?
quote: Cognates are a pair of Telepaths who share complete trust and mental resonance, multiplying their telepathic strength.

q: What is the name of the outdoor school for banished 'Waywards' divided into Right, Left, and Ambi hemispheres?
quote: Exillium is the school for banished youth (Waywards), led by three Masked Coaches representing the Right, Left, and Ambi hemispheres.

q: What is the name of the male alicorn found by the Black Swan to be Silveny's mate?
quote: Greyfell is the silver-gray male alicorn who lives at the Sanctuary and becomes Silveny's mate.

q: What are the names of Silveny and Greyfell's twin baby alicorns born in Flashback?
quote: Sophie helps deliver Silveny and Greyfell's twin alicorn foals and names them Wynn and Luna.

q: What is the name of the underground hideout built by the Black Swan amidst the roots of giant Panakes trees?
quote: Alluveterre is the Black Swan's hidden underground sanctuary located beneath a grove of Panakes trees.

q: Who is the fierce, colorful-haired ogre princess (and daughter of King Dimitar) who becomes Keefe's bodyguard?
quote: Princess Romhilda (Ro) is King Dimitar's daughter and is bound by oath to serve as Keefe's sharp-tongued bodyguard.

q: What is the name of the ogre capital city ruled by King Dimitar?
quote: Ravagog is the heavily fortified capital city of the ogres.

q: What is the name of the subterranean capital city of the dwarves?
quote: Loamnore is the underground kingdom of the dwarves, carved beneath a mountain range.

q: What is Wylie Endal's special ability?
quote: Like his mother Cyrah, Wylie Endal manifests as a powerful Flasher capable of bending light and colors.

q: What ability does Wylie's cousin Maruca Chebota manifest during the series?
quote: Maruca manifests as a Psionipath, able to generate and project impenetrable force fields.

q: Which member of the Neverseen is a powerful Psionipath who traps enemies inside force fields and wears an ability-amplifying addler?
quote: Ruy Ignis is the Neverseen's Psionipath whose force fields blocked nearly all attacks until his bond was broken.

q: Which blond Telepath is the first member of the Neverseen captured by Sophie and her friends during Book 3 (Everblaze)?
quote: Gethen is a high-ranking Telepath in the Neverseen whom Sophie captures in Everblaze (though he is later freed during the Exile break-in).

q: Which strict, pointy-eared Councillor with the Inflictor ability initially distrusts Sophie before becoming one of her staunchest allies?
quote: Councillor Bronte is an ancient Inflictor who initially suspects Sophie's origins before becoming one of her most reliable allies.

q: What is the name of the maximum-security underground prison perched in the center of the earth where the Council holds its worst criminals?
quote: Exile is the labyrinthine maximum-security prison where the Council incarcerates dangerous prisoners and memory-broken criminals.

q: Why do elves experience physical pain, nausea, and psychological trauma leading to a 'memory break' whenever they commit violence?
a: Their registry pendants shock their nervous systems whenever violence occurs
A magical curse placed by the ancient Ancients punishes any act of aggression
Elvin minds are wired with guilt that fractures their sanity when they intentionally harm another living being
The air of the Lost Cities contains spores that react to adrenaline
quote: In Shannon Messenger's world, an elf's mind cannot handle the weight of lethal guilt; intense guilt literally shatters their consciousness.

q: What substance is Sophie DEATHLY allergic to, discovered when she drinks an ability-triggering elixir during a Foxfire alchemy lesson?
quote: Sophie goes into anaphylactic shock after ingesting limbium, requiring Elwin to administer adrenaline and elixir antidotes.

q: Which gnome sacrifices her own life in Book 4 (Neverseen) to transform into a giant Panakes tree whose blossoms cure the gnomish plague?
quote: Calla willingly transforms into a Panakes tree at Havenfield so its healing petals and bark can save her fellow gnomes from the ogres' plague.

q: What are the official mascots of Levels One through Six at Foxfire before the Elite Levels (Silver and Gold Towers)?
a: Silver Alicorn, Golden Phoenix, Emerald Dragon, Sapphire Griffin, Ruby Banshee, and Onyx Kraken
Valiant Gulon, Charging Mastodon, Soaring Halcyon, Prowling Brontodon, Striking Boobrie, and Roaring Sabretooth
Swirling Manticore, Leaping Sasquatch, Diving Plesiosaur, Stalking Chimera, Flaming Gargoyle, and Howling Yeti
Glowing Firefly, Prancing Unicorn, Gliding Pegasus, Charging Rhino, Swooping Falcon, and Roaring Lion
quote: Foxfire's six lower levels use elvin creatures as mascots—starting with Level One's smelly green Valiant Gulon!

q: Why is Sophie able to teleport unlike any other elf in the Lost Cities?
a: She absorbed energy from a shattered Lodestar crystal during her kidnapping
Councillor Bronte unlocked a dormant Ancient gene during her Inflicting lessons
The Black Swan modeled stretches of her DNA on alicorn genetics, giving her the alicorns' instinct to fall through the void
She drank a rare quintessence potion brewed by Kesler Dizznee
quote: Because Project Moonlark used alicorn DNA as an inspiration for Sophie's genetic design, she shares Silveny's ability to enter the void and teleport.

q: What is the name of the sixth element—created by combining spark and shadow—that is the only substance capable of extinguishing Everblaze?
quote: Frissyn is the sixth element forged by combining a Pyrokinetic's spark and a Shade's shadowvapor, used to extinguish Fintan's Everblaze.

q: What kind of special light—found in the stars and harnessed for the fifth element—must be collected safely before Fintan can use it to ignite Everblaze?
quote: Quintessence is the volatile fifth element of starlight that requires careful bottling and is key to sparking Everblaze.

q: What are the marble-sized crystal spheres carried by every Councillor that store Dangerous 'Forgotten Secrets' removed from their own memories?
quote: Each Councillor holds a cache containing encrypted Forgotten Secrets that were wiped from their active memory to protect the world.

q: Which ancient female member of the Neverseen lived inside the Nightfall facility for centuries conducting ruthless experiments on humans and creating illusions?
quote: Vespera Neci Folend is an ancient elf who believed elves should conquer humans and was hidden inside Nightfall before Lady Gisela freed her.

q: What was the name of the Neverseen's Shade who attacked Sophie and Fitz with shadowflux in Flashback before being crushed under the gate at Shadow Thoughts?
quote: Umber was the Neverseen's female Shade who ambushed Sophie and Fitz with shadowflux echoes and perished when the archway collapsed.

q: What is the ability of Trix, the Neverseen member who frequently works alongside Umber and Ruy?
quote: Trix is the Neverseen's Guster, capable of manipulating powerful wind currents and vacuum pockets.

q: What ability does Councillor Terik possess that allows him to sense a person's potential and whether they are telling the truth?
quote: Councillor Terik is the only known Descryer in the Lost Cities, allowing him to read a person's potential.

q: How did Councillor Terik lose his leg during Book 5 (Lodestar)?
a: He was bitten by a mutated gorgodon in the Sanctuary
Brant burned his leg with Everblaze in Eternalia
Fintan's sabotage caused the archetype building / wall at Lumenaria to collapse during the Peace Summit
King Dimitar struck him with an ogre broadsword in Ravagog
quote: When the Neverseen destroyed Lumenaria's castle during the Peace Summit in Lodestar, Terik was trapped in the rubble and lost his leg.

q: What is the name of the ancient palace fortress on a tidal island with glowing green crystal walls that is destroyed during the Peace Summit in Book 5?
quote: Lumenaria is the Neutral Territories' castle hub for prisoner transfers and summits before the Neverseen collapses it in Lodestar.

q: What is the name of Elwin Heslege's pet banshee who hides under his bed and warns when someone is near death?
quote: Bullhorn is Elwin's perceptive pet banshee who curls up with patients who will recover and only shrieks when someone's life is in grave danger.

q: What happens to Wylie's mother, Cyrah Endal, when Fintan and Brant force her to perform an unmapped light leap using a rough crystal?
a: She is imprisoned inside the underwater facility of Nightfall
She fades entirely as her molecules fail to reassemble without sufficient concentration
She suffers a permanent memory break and is placed in Exile
She loses her Flasher ability and is stranded in the Forbidden Cities
quote: Forced to leap with an uncut crystal to an unknown destination, Cyrah fades away completely.

q: What elixir do elves use to help victims recover their cohesion after partially 'fading' from a bad light leap?
quote: Fade fuel is a potent medicine brewed to restore cellular density to elves who have partially faded during a light leap.

q: What white powder sedative do the Neverseen first use when kidnapping Sophie and Dex in Book 1?
quote: Soporidine is an odorless elvin sedative powder blown into victims' faces to induce paralysis and unconsciousness.

q: What is the elvin name for the bottled water that serves as the elves' staple daily drink and tastes slightly sweet and refreshing?
quote: Elves drink bottled water called 'Youth', which keeps them hydrated and vital.

q: What collectibles come inside boxes of Prattles—an elvin treat modeled after human snacks—that Keefe and Sophie collect?
a: Holographic trading cards of famous Councillors
Miniature enamel pins of rare creatures
Carved wooden figurines of the Ancients
quote: Each Prattles box contains a small collectible pin depicting a creature, making certain rare pins (like the alicorn or mockingbird) prized treasures.

q: Which code phrase does the Black Swan use as their ultimate emergency call—signaling that a member is about to be captured or killed?
quote: Calling 'Swan Song' is the Black Swan's final distress code, first invoked by Prentice Endal before his capture.

q: What new abilities does Keefe Sencen manifest in Book 8.5 (Unlocked) after Lady Gisela and Shadowiske expose him to stellarlune and shadowflux?
a: He manifests as a Telepath and a Pyrokinetic
He gains the ability to teleport through shadows and turn invisible
He becomes a Mesmer and a Hydrokinetic
He can sense abilities, issue unbreakable voice commands by speaking purely with raw emotion/power, and numb emotions
quote: After awakening from his coma at the end of Legacy / Unlocked, Keefe develops a terrifying new voice-command power and ability-sensing intuition, prompting him to flee to the Forbidden Cities.

q: What two primal forces do Sophie and her friends discover in Book 9 (Stellarlune) are locked inside Vespera's and Gisela's experiments alongside shadowflux?
quote: In Book 9 (Stellarlune), the search centers on the true nature of stellarlune and the mysterious power source/entity known as Elysian.

q: Who is the secretive Technopath on the Black Swan's Collective who lives in an elaborate workshop and builds pathfinders and gadgets?
quote: Tinker is the female Technopath associated with the Black Swan's Collective who mentors Dex and crafts high-level elvin technology.

q: Which member of the Black Swan's Collective has the Phase-shifter ability that makes their features constantly appear fuzzy and indistinct?
quote: Blur is a Phase-shifter who keeps his body partially phased so his identity remains completely obscured.

q: Which member of the Black Swan's Collective is a Vanisher who wears a weighted cloak that appears to float cleanly without a visible body inside?
quote: Wraith is the Vanisher on the Black Swan's Collective, recognizable by his empty-looking floating cloak.

q: What is the name of the dwarven king (later former king) who sides with the Neverseen during the siege of Loamnore before being overthrown?
quote: King Enki betrays the dwarves by striking a deal with the Neverseen, allowing them to tunnel beneath Loamnore.

q: Who is the calm, dark-skinned Telepath Councillor who serves as the spokesperson for the Council during Formal Tribunals?
quote: Councillor Emery is a Telepath who acts as the moderating voice and chief spokesperson for the twelve Councillors.

q: Who is the Technopath Councillor who oversees the Sanctuary and helps verify technical gadgets for the Council?
quote: Councillor Darek is the Technopath on the Council.

q: Which Councillor is a Polyglot known for communicating with creatures like the mermaids and wearing unusual aquatic hairstyles?
quote: Councillor Clarette is a Polyglot on the Council who negotiates with non-elvin aquatic species.

q: What is the name of the friendly gnome who tends the gardens at Everglen before later helping Sophie and bonding with Bo?
quote: Flori is a young gnome originally from Everglen who sings to plants and becomes part of Sophie's close security and support group.

q: What is the name of the massive troll Empress whose underground breeding hives in Watchward Heath and Nightfall threaten to hatch an army of enhanced newborn trolls?
quote: Empress Pernille rules the trolls while Tarina helps Sophie expose the Neverseen's mutated troll-hive experiments.

q: Which blue-skinned troll guard forms an alliance with Sophie to guard Silveny's babies before betraying and later helping explain the troll hives?
quote: Tarina is the troll warrior assigned to Sophie's detail to protect Silveny during her pregnancy.

q: In Book 7 (Flashback), why do Sophie and Fitz spend weeks confined in the Foxfire Healing Center under Elwin's care?
a: They both suffer severe limbium poisoning after infiltrating Nightfall
Fintan burns them with Everblaze during the battle of Eternalia
A collapsing force field from Ruy Ignis shatters their concentration nexuses
Umber's shadowflux attack leaves fading 'echoes' of darkness inside Sophie's wrist and Fitz's chest that threaten to consume them
quote: In Flashback, Umber strikes Sophie and Fitz with shadowflux, leaving deadly echoes inside their bodies that only heal after weeks in the Healing Center.
